sentences.en: The whole sky lit up and there was an explosion.
sentences.zh: 整个天空都被照亮了，然后发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: Just as we are talking, there was a loud explosion.
sentences.zh: 就在我们说话的时候，传来一声巨响，应该是发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: The explosion did a lot of damage to the building.
sentences.zh: 那次爆炸对那栋建筑造成了很大的破坏。

senses.zh: （Explosion）《引爆者》（一部中国动作、犯罪电影）。
